  "stats": "Speed: 15cm\nTurn: 45°\nShield: 4\nArmour: 6+ front / 5+\nTurret: 4\nBase: 60mm\n\n• Demiurg Stronghold class ships are heavily automated and count their Ld value as 10 at the start of the battle. The Stronghold's Ld will drop by -1 for each point of damage it suffers, but its Ld value will not drop any further than 5.\n• Bridge smashed critical hits will not inflict additional Leadership loss on a Demiurg ship, but instead cause an extra point of damage (and possible attendant Ld loss) on the vessel.\n• A Stronghold class vessel is worth 350 Victory points normally but in a pure Demiurg fleet or one fighting against Orks it is worth 400 Victory points instead to reflect its extra determination.
